faq.a: A grid reference is a set of numbers that shows where a place is on a map with grid lines. Four figures give the square; six figures pin the spot inside the square.
asks: What is a four-figure grid reference?

faq.a: Eastings are the up-and-down lines, numbered along the bottom, and they increase as you go east. Northings are the side-to-side lines, numbered up the side, and they increase as you go north.
asks: Which number comes first in a grid reference?

faq.q: How do I find the tenths in a square?
faq.a: Imagine the square split into ten equal strips across and ten up. Count how many tenths along and how many tenths up your place sits, and add each as the third figure.
asks: How do you get six figures?

faq.q: How can I remember which way to read first?
faq.a: Say along the corridor, then up the stairs. Read the eastings along the bottom first, then the northings up the side.
asks: Along the corridor and up the stairs

faq.q: How accurate is a six-figure grid reference?
faq.a: On a map where each grid square is 1 km across, a six-figure reference finds a place to within 100 metres. A four-figure one only gives the whole 1 km square.
asks: Why use six figures instead of four?

facts: On Ordnance Survey maps of Great Britain each grid square is 1 km across, so a six-figure reference is accurate to 100 m.
In a grid reference, eastings are always given before northings.

quiz.say: Which part of a grid reference comes first?
quiz.show: In a grid reference, first comes…

options.show: The easting, read along the bottom
options.say: The easting, read along the bottom

options.show: The northing, read up the side
options.say: The northing, read up the side

quiz.why: Along the corridor, then up the stairs: eastings first, then northings.

wrong.1: Northings come second, up the stairs after along the corridor.
wrong.2: The order is fixed: eastings always come first.

quiz.say: A school is in square 2748. It is 5 tenths across and 3 tenths up. What is its six-figure reference?
quiz.show: Square 2748, 5 tenths across, 3 tenths up. The six-figure reference is…
quiz.why: Easting 27 plus 5 tenths makes 275; northing 48 plus 3 tenths makes 483. Together: 275483.

wrong.1: The tenths are in the wrong places: it should be 27 then 5, and 48 then 3.
wrong.2: That puts the northing first; eastings must come first.
